svg.text: Today's flow · from an idea to production, with what exists and what is missing
Describes the product in plain words
11 stages, each approved before the next
Issues with tests, dependencies, ready label
Deploy repo · bots · protection · Argo CD
One issue, one sandbox, one pull request
stand-in builder; real Qwen not tried
Checks pass, review, only Gökhan merges
Staging automatic, prod by approved PR
NOT BUILT YET, OUTSIDE THE STEPS ABOVE
Pull-request previews · migrations as a pre-sync job · secrets manager · staging smoke test before the prod PR
Status as of 21 November 2026. Tried means run end to end on a temporary sandbox cluster, not on a real server.
